name: volume-reaches-core
description: Setting the volume group's value reaches mpv as a 0..100 volume, and the widget keeps the 0..1 fraction it was given.

steps.name: hasVideo
steps.note: The volume path ends in surface_->setVolume on a live core; asserting before the engine exists would read nothing.

steps.name: volume
steps.note: The declared Q_PROPERTY volume (ShellSliders.hpp:95), written through the real setter so it emits volumeChanged exactly as a drag does. The widget speaks 0..1; the core speaks 0..100.
A bounded settle for the mpv write to be observable, not the synchroniser - the property comparison below is what decides the scenario.

assertions.note: The whole Qt-to-core hop: VolumeGroup::volumeChanged -> PlayerShell::onVolume -> PlayerDialog.cpp:1177-1180 multiplies by 100 -> mpv. 0.5 on the widget is 50 in the core, and this is what fails if the scaling or the emission is ever dropped.
The widget must hold the 0..1 fraction it was set to rather than the 0..100 the core uses - the same number in two scales is the trap this pairing exists to catch.
